rows.Benefit Description.Hospice/ End of life: These benefits will be paid if the hospice care program begins after a person's primary doctor certifies terminal illness and life expectancy of six months or less and any services or inpatient hospice stay that is part of the program is: • Provided while the person is covered by this Plan • Ordered by the supervising doctor • Charged by the hospice care program • Provided within six months from the date the person entered or reentered (after a period of remission) a hospice care program Remission is the halt or actual reduction in the progression of illness resulting in discharge from a hospice care program with no further expenses incurred. A readmission within three months of a prior discharge is considered as the same period of care. A new period begins after three months from a prior discharge with maximum benefits available.
